scene: The caught map reveals three midnight routes leaving the flats.
picture: Across flat brick roof platforms, the tall man in a red poncho, straw hat, and guitar stands left of centre holding a map. On the far left, a mechanical book cart lift hangs waiting. Centre right, a glowing green night bus idles. On the far right, a swinging ferris wheel gondola sits open.
shown: A pulley-suspended book cart lift sits open on the far left platform
A glowing green night bus idles patiently at the centre curb
An open ferris wheel gondola hangs ready on the far right
